title: Exact normalized coupled-map synchronization threshold
statement: For a complete m-label Fold in the normalized drive-response transverse channel, the exact residual multiplier m(One-g) uniquely forces g=(m-1)/m, expansion below, neutrality at the boundary and contraction above; half-One follows at m=2, without universalizing arbitrary topology.
